problems.title: palin
problems.tech: count each letter with `cnt[26]`; the letters seen an odd number of times decide the answer

problems.title: orange
problems.tech: the pieces per orange are `n / gcd(n, m)`

problems.title: paper
problems.tech: every fold halves one side: halve while the side is even and count the folds

problems.title: div
problems.tech: the number is a string: the last digit decides 2 and 5, the digit sum decides 3

problems.title: princess
problems.tech: `a(a+1)/2` flowers in all; try the shares one by one

problems.title: bact
problems.tech: `K` goes up to 10^18, but the count soon stops changing: simulate until it does

problems.title: mobile
problems.tech: days since 1 January 2015 from an array of month lengths, then `% 7`

problems.title: deliteli
problems.tech: count the divisors of each number, stopping at the square root

problems.title: grump
problems.tech: play the board game move by move: an array for the squares, a counter for skipped turns

problems.title: painting
problems.tech: corners, edges, faces and the inside of the cube: one formula for each

problems.title: treasure
problems.tech: `k * a` is divisible by `b` once every `b / gcd(a, b)` days

problems.title: mermaid
problems.tech: look at the neighbours of every `'*'` first; otherwise simulate the swim along the string

problems.title: rectcut
problems.tech: each cut moves one border: keep the four borders, then multiply in `long long`

problems.title: number
problems.tech: numbers of the form `y(y+1)`: count the `y` that land in `[M, N]`, in `long long`

problems.title: odd
problems.tech: five odd digits count like base 5: take the digits of `n` in base 5, then turn 0..4 into 1, 3, 5, 7, 9

problems.title: shisho
problems.tech: reverse each four-digit number with `/` and `%`, then test it for a prime up to the square root

problems.title: word
problems.tech: turn `'*'` into spaces, drop the punctuation, then check each word against the rules

problems.title: grip
problems.tech: step through the calendar day by day, counting only the weekdays

problems.title: sum
problems.tech: the multiples of `lcm(P, Q)` in `[A, B]`: count them, then add them with the `n(n+1)/2` idea, in `long long`

problems.title: triplet
problems.tech: counting as you go: `cnt[26]` for the letters before and after each middle letter, then multiply

problems.title: pyramid
problems.tech: fill the layers in spiral order with `dr` / `dc`, then print level by level

problems.title: segments
problems.tech: do not list the pieces: `a[i]` lies inside `i * (n - i + 1)` of them, in `long long`

problems.title: equation
problems.tech: mark every `x*a + y*b` up to `L` in a `seen[]` array, then count the unmarked values

problems.title: trimino
problems.tech: for each piece number collect its cells; check there are three and that they touch

problems.title: div3
problems.tech: digit sum `% 3`: raise the leftmost digit that can fix it

problems.title: hidepencil
problems.tech: for every cell look along the four directions for the tallest neighbour

problems.title: parts
problems.tech: `K` different parts need at least `K(K+1)/2`; try the divisors of `N` up to the square root

problems.title: number
problems.tech: 100 digits in base `b`: multiply the big number by `b`, add the next digit, repeat

problems.title: period
problems.tech: long division of `1 / n`; remember where each remainder first appeared to find the repeating part

problems.title: rocks
problems.tech: drop the stones one at a time on the grid and apply the sliding rules

problems.title: robo
problems.tech: follow the commands keeping position and direction, then build the shortest command list to the same state

problems.title: like
problems.tech: try every shift of one word against the other, count matching letters, reduce with `gcd`

problems.title: equ
problems.tech: for each base 2..10, add or multiply the long numbers digit by digit and compare with `C`
